title: Moving to a New Apartment
subtitle: 考点：搬家 / pack up / 房间名称
passage: Last week, Amy's family moved to a new apartment. It is in a big community near her school. The apartment has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and a small balcony.
Before the move, everyone packed up their things. Amy put her books, toys and clothes into boxes. She wrote “Amy's room” on each box. Her father was careful with the plates because they break easily.

On the first night, the family ate pizza on the floor of the living room. Amy's room is next to the balcony, so she can see the trees from her window. She hung up her favourite poster on the wall. She loves her new home, but she also misses her old friends.
vocab: apartment 公寓 · community 小区 · balcony 阳台 · pack up 打包 · hang up 挂起 · careful 小心的 · poster 海报
